(a) the nitrogenous compounds are the dominant contributor in the precipitation chemistry in the lake Victoria catchment (39%), (b) the wet deposition of nitrogen is 8.5 kg N ha-1 yr-1 with 26% of dissolved organic nitrogen, (c) the total atmospheric nitrogen deposition is estimated to 15 kg N ha- 1 yr-1, and (d) the lake is exposed to eutrification.

1) Wet nitrogen deposition is the dominant contributor to the Lake Victoria catchments (58%); 2) Nitrogen deposition is dominated by livestock and fertilizers (39%), followed by biomass burning and neighboring fires; 3) The lake is exposed to nitrogen eutrophication (15 kgN ha-1 yr-1).
